set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm ci --ignore-scripts >/dev/null; npm audit --json >/tmp/matrixhub-audit-all.json || true; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p='/tmp/matrixhub-audit-all.json'
d=json.load(open(p))
print('METADATA', json.dumps(d.get('metadata',{}).get('vulnerabilities',{}), sort_keys=True))
for name,v in sorted(d.get('vulnerabilities',{}).items(), key=lambda kv: ({'critical':0,'high':1,'moderate':2,'low':3,'info':4}.get(kv[1].get('severity'),9), kv[0])):
    print(json.dumps({'name':name,'severity':v.get('severity'),'isDirect':v.get('isDirect'),'range':v.get('range'),'nodes':v.get('nodes'),'via':v.get('via'),'effects':v.get('effects'),'fixAvailable':v.get('fixAvailable')}, sort_keys=True))
